posts.text:

Codex、Copilot、Gemini 的額度也能一起看。

免費下載，App 內可以完整試用 24 小時，之後想繼續用就一次買斷 UsageNow Pro，不是訂閱。
一個人獨立開發，跟 Anthropic 沒有任何關係。連結放留言。

posts.text:
大家好，我是一個人做 iOS App 的獨立開發者，平常寫 code 很依賴 Claude Code，有時也會切到 Codex。
最近做了一個小 App，想請社團的大家幫忙看看、給點意見：UsageNow，在 iPhone 主畫面上顯示各家 AI 方案還剩多少額度、什麼時候重置。

會做這個，是因為被額度擋過太多次：5 小時額度看起來還夠，任務跑到一半才發現是每週額度先用完；或是公司帳號跟自己的帳號搞混，不知道哪個先重置。

目前支援：
・Claude：5 小時與每週額度，含各模型的每週上限
・ChatGPT Codex：5 小時與每週額度
・GitHub Copilot：premium requests、Chat、程式碼補全
・Gemini：各模型的每日請求配額

其他功能：
・每個額度都有即時重置倒數，也顯示確切的重置時間（照你手機的時間格式）
・提醒自己設：選 5 小時、每週或全部額度，輸入任意百分比（例如 90 或 98），要設幾個都可以；每個額度每個週期只提醒一次，也可以在額度恢復時通知
・多帳號並排（工作／個人、Pro／Max），可以依 5 小時重置、每週重置、用量高低、名稱或服務排序，也能拖曳調整順序
・主畫面、鎖定畫面小工具各種尺寸都有，在小工具上就能翻看所有帳號、點一下重新整理；Apple Watch 也有複雜功能
・iPhone、iPad、Apple Watch 都能用

隱私先講清楚：登入是在各服務自己的官方登入頁，登入狀態存在裝置的鑰匙圈，App 只跟這些服務本身連線。沒有 UsageNow 伺服器、不用註冊帳號、沒有追蹤。

價格也先講：免費下載，App 內可以完整試用 24 小時，之後想繼續用是一次買斷 UsageNow Pro，沒有訂閱。

這是我自己一個人做的獨立 App，跟 Anthropic、OpenAI、GitHub、Microsoft、Google 都沒有關係。

想請教大家：
1. 你最常撞到的是哪一種額度？
2. 小工具上你最想一眼看到什麼？
3. 這樣的登入方式你放心嗎？哪裡讓你有疑慮？

歡迎拍磚，覺得哪裡不好用、哪裡寫得不清楚都可以直接講，我會一則一則看、一則一則回。
App Store 連結放在留言。

posts.first_comment:
Hi HN, I'm the developer (solo, based in Taiwan).

UsageNow is an iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch app that shows how much of each AI plan you have left and exactly when it resets: Claude (5-hour and weekly limits, including per-model weekly caps), ChatGPT Codex (5-hour and weekly windows), GitHub Copilot (premium requests, chat, code completions) and Gemini (daily quotas per model).

I built it because the weekly limit kept being the one that stopped long agent runs, and the numbers live in a different place for every service and every account. You can keep several accounts side by side, sort by whichever resets next, and set alerts at any percentage; each fires once per limit per cycle. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus Watch complications.

On sign-in: you log in on each service's own login page, the sign-in stays in the device Keychain, and the app only talks to those services. There's no UsageNow server, no account, no tracking.

Pricing: free download with a 24-hour full trial, then a one-time unlock. No subscription. It's independent and not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, Microsoft or Google.

I'd especially like feedback on the security model and on what you'd want to see at a glance.

posts.title: I kept hitting Claude's weekly limit mid-task, so I built an iPhone app that shows every limit and when it resets
posts.text:
Disclosure up front: I'm the solo developer, and this is a paid app after a 24-hour free trial (a one-time UsageNow Pro unlock, no subscription). It's independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.

Why I made it: more than once I started a long Claude Code task because the 5-hour window looked fine, and the weekly limit (or a per-model weekly cap) was what actually stopped me halfway. I also use a work account and a personal one, and kept losing track of which one resets when.

What it does:
- Claude's 5-hour session limit and weekly limits, including per-model weekly caps, each with a live countdown and the exact reset time in your local format
- Alerts you define: pick 5-hour, weekly or all limits, type any percentage (90, 98, whatever), add as many as you like. Each fires once per limit per cycle, plus an optional alert when a limit is back
- Multiple accounts side by side (work/personal, Pro/Max), sorted by next 5-hour reset, next weekly reset, usage high/low, name or service, or dragged into your own order
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets in every size; flip through accounts on the widget and tap to refresh; Apple Watch complications
- It also covers ChatGPT Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini quotas if you mix tools
- iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch; the interface is in 50 languages, switchable in Settings

Privacy, since it needs you to sign in: you sign in on Anthropic's own login page (and each other service's own page), the sign-in stays in your device Keychain, and the app only talks to those services. There's no UsageNow server, no account, no tracking.

Honest caveat: if you use one account and you're always at the terminal, the usage view Claude already gives you is enough. This is for glancing from the phone, Lock Screen or Watch, and for juggling several accounts.

App Store: {LINK}

I'd genuinely like criticism: what's confusing, what's missing, and whether the sign-in model makes you uneasy. I'll reply to every comment.
